findings.evidence:
- Planner side: `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go:2231-2256` skips `BuildIndexMergeTableScan` when `canBuildSingleMVIndexOnlyIndexMerge` returns true, leaving `cop.TablePlan` nil (index-only IndexMerge for MV index).
- The gate is EXPLAIN-only and explicitly acknowledged as non-executable: `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go:2281-2283` (“planner-only optimization… before executor support is added”, requires `StmtCtx.InExplainStmt && !InExplainAnalyzeStmt`).
- Executor side confirms non-executability: `pkg/executor/builder.go:4772-4778` errors if `len(v.TablePlans)==0` except for plain EXPLAIN where it returns `nil` executor.
- EXPLAIN context is set before optimizing the target stmt: `pkg/executor/select.go:1081-1089` sets `StmtCtx.InExplainStmt` and `StmtCtx.InExplainAnalyzeStmt` for `*ast.ExplainStmt` and then rewrites `s = explainStmt.Stmt`, so optimizer sees the EXPLAIN flags while building the target plan.
findings.fix:
Avoid emitting non-executable physical plans in default `EXPLAIN` output:
- Preferred: implement executor support for index-only MV IndexMerge and remove the EXPLAIN-only gating so `EXPLAIN` and real execution share the same plan.
- If executor support isn’t ready: keep building a normal executable IndexMerge (with table scan) even in plain `EXPLAIN`, or make the hypothetical index-only shape opt-in via a session variable and/or clearly annotate the plan output as “not executable / planner-only”.
findings.impact: User-visible compatibility/diagnostics risk: plain `EXPLAIN` can show an index-only MV IndexMerge (no TableRowIDScan) that cannot be executed and will differ from both (a) actual query execution (which must still include a table scan) and (b) `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` (where the EXPLAIN-only gate is disabled). This can mislead performance debugging and tooling that assumes `EXPLAIN` reflects the runnable plan.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (`git log 44174cf..upstream/master -- pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go pkg/executor/builder.go`) and found no follow-up commits touching these files; behavior still present in `upstream/master` at `3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd`.
findings.verify:
- Compare `EXPLAIN FORMAT='plan_tree' ...` vs `EXPLAIN ANALYZE FORMAT='plan_tree' ...` for a single-partial-path MV IndexMerge query with covered projection; they should not diverge purely due to EXPLAIN mode.
- Ensure executing the query (non-EXPLAIN) never produces a plan requiring `buildIndexMergeReader` to hit the `len(TablePlans)==0` error path.
- If keeping any EXPLAIN-only behavior, add/adjust tests to assert the output is explicitly marked as non-executable/hypothetical.
findings.what: Plain `EXPLAIN` is made to output an index-only MV IndexMerge plan by constructing `PhysicalIndexMergeReader` with `TablePlan=nil`, but this plan is explicitly “not executable yet” and is blocked from being built/executed outside plain EXPLAIN. This creates an intentional divergence where `EXPLAIN` (non-analyze) can show a plan shape that the executor cannot run, and which will differ from actual execution and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`.

subject: planner: enable index-only MV IndexMerge only for single covered partial path (optimizer part) (#66996)
summary: Commit introduces an EXPLAIN-only planner optimization that removes the IndexMerge table scan (sets `TablePlan=nil`) for a single covered MV IndexMerge partial path, plus nil-tolerant plan traversal and an executor builder exception so plain EXPLAIN can display the new plan shape.
